በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ወበእንተዝኬ: በእንተዝ — and therefore, for this reason (ወ- + በእንተ + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ተብህለ: ብህለ — it is said (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ)
ኢትፍራህ: ፈርሀ — do not fear (ኢ- + 2ms jussive, f-r-h)
ነሢኦታ: ነሥአ — taking her (infinitive ነሢኦት + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ታ), accusative, n-ś-ʾ)
ዘይትወለድ: ተወልደ — who is born (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ወለደ)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ወተወልደ: ተወልደ — and was born (ወ- + 3m sg passive perfect)
አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God')
ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
ዘመጽአ: መጽአ — who came (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
ለኵልነ: ኵሉ — for all of us (ለ- + ኵል- + -ነ '1cp')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
መፍቀሬ: መፍቀሪ — lover of (noun, construct, from ፈቀረ 'love')
ይደሉ: ደለወ — be fitting, be due (3ms imperfect)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
